title: The Knight Clears the File
setup: Your queen would love the e-file, but your own knight on e5 stands in the way. Find the move that clears it and gives Black no time.
hint: Move the knight with check, so Black never gets a spare move to guard the eighth rank.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Nxf7+}} clears the e-file with check. If the king steps to g8, the queen mates on e8 at once, so Black takes the knight: {{Rxf7}}.

Now {{Qe8+}}, and the only block is {{Rf8}}, the rook that just left the seventh rank. {{Qxf8#}}: your bishop on d6 guards the queen, and the king has no square left.
